explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/663: with q(n,k) the least prime not dividing ∏_{i=1}^k (n+i), is q(n,k) < (1+o(1)) log n for fixed k ≥ 2 and large n? The statement asserts, for each k ≥ 2, an o(1) error such that eventually the least such prime q satisfies q < (1 + error n) log n. q's minimality is encoded explicitly. Faithful.
